rationale: Pivot to the new logistic_elastic_net family for HP sweep — first-run degree=1 default already beats both baselines on avg_ann (-8.8% vs random_topk -30.2%, rule_only -27.8%) and hits +84% ann / 35% WR on W3, the bear window every tree-family trainer fails on. The HP space is wide (C/l1_ratio/pos_class_weight/degree∈{1,2}/max_iter) and untouched; degree=2 in particular is unexplored and adds 4560 interaction features that should lift the WR ceiling that all 37 prior trainers saturate at ~30%.
